title: Battle of Sacheon (1592)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sacheon (1592)", at revision 1371749113, opens: "The Battle of Sacheon was a naval engagement on May 29, 1592 during the Imjin War (1592–98). It occurred at Sacheon where Yi Sunsin's fleet managed to destroy 13 large Japanese ships. It was the first battle of Admiral Yi's 2nd Campaign in the Imjin War, between Japan and Korea, when the turtle ship was first used." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q482970, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "naval battle (1592)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
